baseline_models.focus_anchor: The Form II active participle in للمكذبين profiles agents performing تكذيب, not merely people who possess an incorrect belief.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus phrase assigns woe to people who actively attach falsehood to a report, event, or bearer of truth. Agency is therefore central: the target group tries to alter the standing of something by declaring it false.

activation_trace.role: Attributing falsehood to a thing or person supplies the literal act and makes active discrediting the model's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Woe belongs generally to people who believe something false.
changed_reading.after: Woe belongs to agents who actively brand a truth, report, or messenger as false.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The participial label للمكذبين can characterize an ongoing mode of agency, while the root inventory explicitly extends falsehood across speech and action.
baseline_models.mechanism: Falsehood need not remain a verbal proposition. Speech and conduct can jointly make a lived counterclaim to truth, so the label can identify a practice of falsification rather than a single opinion.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood in either saying or doing broadens the literal field and lets the participle name enacted contradiction.

changed_reading.before: The condemned act is verbal denial alone.
changed_reading.after: The condemned identity is sustained by speech and conduct that together enact a false account of reality.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root of المكذبين includes a branch in which a charge proves true only by being carried through and proves false when it fails.
baseline_models.mechanism: The deniers issue a countercharge against truth, but that charge remains exposed to an eventual outcome test. Woe can therefore anticipate not only punishment for denial but the public failure of the deniers' own falsifying claim to carry through.

activation_trace.role: A charge that succeeds or fails by follow-through supplies an outcome test for the agents' counterclaim.

changed_reading.before: The verse condemns a settled class called deniers.
changed_reading.after: The verse anticipates the moment when the deniers' own counterclaim fails its test of fulfillment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence moves from dispatch through spreading, differentiation, casting, warning, appointment, realization, timing, and judgment. Against that sequence, المكذبين are not rejecting an inert statement; they are trying to discredit a process already in motion toward a fixed discriminating event.

activation_trace.role: Active attribution of falsehood anchors the response of the focus agents to the unfolding announcement.
Sending and setting forth literally initiates the sequence and makes the denied matter something dispatched into motion.
Opening, spreading, and branching literally give the dispatched process spatial propagation.
Differentiating two things literally supplies the process's truth-separating function.
Casting something down literally deposits the reminder into the unfolding sequence.
A warning that awakens caution gives the cast reminder its prospective force.
An appointment bounded by time or place turns the warning into a scheduled prospect.
Falling and becoming fixed supplies the promised event's transition from prospect to realized fact.
Setting a time or limit gives the process a determinate terminus.
Judgment that separates truth from falsehood supplies the terminus's adjudicating function.

structural_cues: 77:1-7 advances through coordinated participles into the assertion that the promised event will occur.
77:8-14 moves from cosmic alterations to timing and the named Day of Decision before the first matching refrain at 77:15.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered motion, warning, appointment, realization, timing, and decision images. I infer a causal-temporal chain whose advance is what the focus agents attempt to discredit; a live alternative is that these are parallel signs rather than stages of one process.

changed_reading.before: The focus condemns rejection of a static proposition.
changed_reading.after: The focus condemns active resistance to a dispatched, spreading, differentiating process already moving toward its fixed decision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same focus sentence recurs after successive displays of promise, destruction, creation, earthly containment, judgment, reward, brief enjoyment, and embodied refusal. The carry-through branch turns each recurrence into a verdict checkpoint: another displayed charge has held, while the deniers' countercharge has failed again.

activation_trace.role: The success or failure of a charge by follow-through anchors the focus refrain as an outcome verdict.
The first matching refrain establishes the repeated lexical checkpoint after the opening charge reaches decision.
The last matching refrain confirms that the outcome-test pattern continues through embodied refusal.

structural_cues: Each recurrence follows a distinct scene rather than appearing only once as a general conclusion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact repetition and the branch's carry-through test. I infer that recurrence repeatedly audits the preceding scene against the deniers' claim; an alternative is that the refrain is emphatic punctuation without a separate evidentiary test each time.

changed_reading.before: The focus is one interchangeable threat among several.
changed_reading.after: The focus is one recurring verdict station at which another claim has carried through and the deniers' counterclaim fails again.

context_deltas.mechanism: The middle sequence nests life within calibrated holders: creation is measured, the embryo rests in a stable lodging until a bounded term, and the earth gathers living and dead while fixed heights and watering sustain it. Denial consequently becomes an active mislabeling of an observable system of measure, containment, transition, and provision.

activation_trace.role: Declaring something false anchors the model as the agents' response to the material system.
Estimating and measuring a thing literally makes calibrated formation the mechanism's first operation.
Fixity and settlement supply the stable holding environment for formation.
A quantity reaching its limit gives the holding period a measured boundary.
Gathering and gripping within a receptacle makes the earth a second containing structure.
Living beings supply one class held by the earthly container.
Loss of life supplies the complementary class and makes the container span life's transition.
Firm rooting and stability add anchoring to the earth's containing function.
Giving drink supplies the sustaining flow within the stabilized system.

structural_cues: 77:20-23 runs from weak originating fluid through a secure lodging to a known measure, followed by the refrain at 77:24.
77:25-27 presents the earth as a holder of living and dead, then adds anchoring heights and fresh water before the refrain at 77:28.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two sequences of measure, lodging, containment, life-state, anchoring, and water. I infer that they form nested material evidence which the focus agents misclassify as false; a live alternative is that the verses list separate benefactions without one containment mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The deniers reject only a verbal announcement about judgment.
changed_reading.after: The deniers actively falsify the measured holding processes embodied in their own formation and inhabited earth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The imperative sends the addressees toward the very thing they had declared false. Occurrence becomes presence and then place: they enter a nominal shade whose protective function does not suffice. Their attempted verbal cancellation is reversed into compulsory spatial encounter.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a thing false anchors the verbal act that the context reverses into encounter.
Unimpeded departure literally supplies motion toward the denied object's new spatial reality.
The context explicitly identifies the destination as what the addressees had been declaring false.
Occurrence and presence in time sharpen the reversal from alleged nonreality to present encounter.
Covering shade supplies the apparent refuge that constitutes the destination.
Sufficiency is explicitly negated, stripping the nominal refuge of effective protection.

structural_cues: 77:29 grammatically joins the command to depart with the relative object that the addressees used to deny.
77:30-31 immediately specifies that destination as a three-branched shade that neither shades nor protects from flame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies commanded movement, the denied object, occurrence, apparent shade, and failed sufficiency. I infer a reversal in which a failed speech act becomes a compulsory destination; an alternative is a punishment itinerary with no claim about how denial itself functions.

changed_reading.before: The focus names people who verbally reject a future event.
changed_reading.after: The focus names people whose attempted cancellation of that event ends with the denied reality becoming the place they must enter.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, the deniers' available channels close in sequence: speech is absent, permission for an excuse is withheld, all parties are gathered into one arena, and strategic counteraction is challenged. The active falsifiers are thus shown at the point where both verbal defense and tactical control fail.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood enacted in speech or action anchors the two forms of agency that the adjacent context removes.
Literal speech supplies the first channel of denial, which the verse marks as unavailable.
Permission to act or speak supplies the authorization that is withheld from any defense.
Excuse and exculpation supply the specific defensive speech that cannot proceed.
Gathering dispersed parties into one whole creates the closed arena of accountability.
Strategic contrivance supplies the final control mechanism, exposed as powerless by the direct challenge.

structural_cues: 77:35-36 removes speech and authorized excuse; 77:38 gathers the parties; 77:39 ends with a direct challenge to use any remaining strategy.
The focus refrain at 77:40 follows this sequence immediately.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies silencing, withheld permission, blocked excuse, gathering, and challenged strategy. I infer that these are successive failures of the agency used to sustain denial; an alternative is that they are separate features of judgment rather than a coordinated collapse.

changed_reading.before: The deniers are simply people holding an incorrect position.
changed_reading.after: The deniers are active falsifiers encountered exactly when their verbal defenses and strategic countercontrol have both run out.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, protected people receive ease explicitly because of intentional work and good-doing, while the criminal group is told to enjoy benefit only briefly. The contrast tests truth in conduct and yield: one enacted orientation receives fitting return, while denial's practical program produces a truncated benefit.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood extending through action anchors denial as conduct whose outcome can be compared.
Placing oneself within protection supplies the contrasting enacted orientation.
Intentional work literally identifies conduct as the stated basis of the favorable outcome.
Matching an act with its return supplies the mechanism that tests each mode of conduct by its yield.
Doing what is good specifies the conduct receiving the matched favorable return.
Enjoyed benefit supplies the rival practical yield promised by the criminal orientation.
Smallness literally truncates that rival benefit and exposes its poor yield.
Guilt and offense identify the agents whose brief enjoyment is contrasted with recompensed good-doing.

structural_cues: 77:41-44 follows the focus with protected shade, provision, an explicit because-of-your-work clause, and recompense for good-doers.
After the refrain at 77:45, 77:46 pairs eating and enjoyment with little duration and criminal identity, followed by another refrain at 77:47.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two groups, intentional work, matched return, enjoyed benefit, and explicit brevity. I infer that this contrast operationalizes denial as a way of acting tested by its yield; an alternative is that conduct and reward merely describe consequences without expanding the focus label.

changed_reading.before: Denial is primarily an epistemic error about a report.
changed_reading.after: Denial is an enacted program whose short-lived yield is contrasted with conduct that enters protection and receives a fitting return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final sequence converts speech into a bodily test: a command is uttered, but the addressees do not bow. The closing question then asks what later discourse could produce trusting assent. The focus label becomes persistent refusal enacted by the body and carried to the exhaustion of further address.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood in speech or action anchors the shift from rejected discourse to embodied noncompliance.
An uttered statement supplies the explicit command against which bodily response is tested.
Humbling oneself literally supplies the requested bodily act whose refusal enacts denial.
Renewed report or discourse supplies the hypothetical next address whose efficacy is questioned.
Temporal laterness extends the test beyond the present discourse and closes off a deferred remedy.
Heart-settled assent supplies the response that no later discourse is expected to elicit.

structural_cues: 77:48 places command and refusal in the same repeated root construction, then 77:49 repeats the focus refrain.
77:50 closes the surah by asking which discourse after this could lead to belief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an uttered command, repeated bodily refusal, and a final question about later discourse and assent. I infer that non-bowing is denial made bodily and that the question marks exhaustion of further address; an alternative is that non-bowing is only one consequence of denial, not part of its mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns verbal rejection of information.
changed_reading.after: The focus concerns a refusal that passes from rejected speech into the body and persists until no later discourse is expected to open assent.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers the root's deceptive-cloth image from an object's appearance to the agents' relation to apparent shelter. It remains anchored in the focus root and in the exact contrast between shade that cannot shade and protective shade; downstream prose should present it as a material analogy, not as the lexical gloss of المكذبين.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root has a branch for a patterned cloth whose visible state deceives, allowing falsity to be modeled as a mismatch between appearance and function.

activation_trace.role: A surface whose appearance deceives supplies the material template for apparent refuge without protective truth.
Covering shade supplies the refuge's visible and nominal appearance.
Protective shelter supplies the function explicitly denied to that apparent shade.
Failed sufficiency exposes the gap between the refuge's name and its actual performance.
Actual prevention of harm supplies the protective relation enjoyed by the contrasting group.
Effective shelter completes the contrast with the shade whose appearance could not deliver its function.

changed_reading.before: The deniers are wrong about the truth of a statement.
changed_reading.after: The deniers inhabit appearance-level falsity: what presents itself as shelter fails to shelter, while genuine protection belongs elsewhere.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus branch concerns milk that disappears despite an expectation of duration, not a human active participle. It remains worth carrying because 77:46 explicitly joins enjoyment to littleness; downstream prose should mark it as a temporal-material analogy for a failed forecast, never as a direct translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root includes a branch in which an expected supply fails to last, opening a duration-based model of falsification.

activation_trace.role: A provision that vanishes instead of lasting supplies the failed-duration template for the agents' operative expectation.
Extended retention for enjoyment supplies the duration that the verse immediately constrains.
Littleness truncates the expected enjoyment and makes its promise fail to hold.

changed_reading.before: The deniers merely reject a future claim.
changed_reading.after: The deniers live by a contrary forecast that present enjoyment will hold, but its duration itself proves false.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the root branch describes a wild animal that runs, stops, and looks behind, which is form-distant from the active participle. The repeated command to set out and the explicit context occurrence of the same denial root keep the trajectory anchored; downstream prose should qualify it as a spatial analogy for recoil and compelled advance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root has a branch of forward motion interrupted by stopping to look back, permitting denial to be tested as a broken trajectory.

activation_trace.role: Running followed by a backward-looking stop supplies the spatial image of recoil within a course.
Unimpeded departure supplies the forward motion now imposed on those who had recoiled.
The context's denial occurrence directly joins the interrupted-course image to the destination they resisted.
The repeated departure command reinforces compelled continuation rather than another backward stop.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a stationary intellectual position.
changed_reading.after: Denial is an interrupted course marked by recoil, while judgment commands the deniers forward into what they had stopped before.

strongest_changes: The active discrediting in المكذبين becomes resistance to a dispatched process already advancing toward a fixed decision.
The repeated refrain functions as a sequence of verdict checkpoints after distinct claims and demonstrations carry through.
The denied event reverses from an attempted verbal cancellation into a destination, followed locally by the collapse of speech, excuse, and strategy.
The latter surah makes denial behavioral: conduct is tested by its yield, refusal is enacted by the body, and further discourse reaches an endpoint.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet lets the identical focus refrain inherit a different mechanism at each recurrence while retaining one lexical anchor. The branch inventory also exposed material and spatial readings that a single consensus gloss would likely suppress.
remaining_uncertainties: The active participial form most directly supports declaring false; the charge-failure, deceptive-surface, failed-duration, and interrupted-motion branches remain analogical and form-distant.
The causal unity assigned to the opening participial sequence and the nested-containment unity assigned to 77:20-27 are reader-supplied constructions; the packet also permits parallel lists.
The judgment commands and reward contrasts may characterize the deniers without becoming part of the lexical content of المكذبين.
